name: Deer
desc: Deer with fawn, grazing or standing still
code: const s=ctx.scale||1; const x=ctx.x||0; const y=ctx.y||0; const col=ctx.color||'#C4862D'; const fawn=ctx.hasFawn!==false; const bob=Math.sin(mt*0.6)*2; svg += `<g transform="translate(${x},${y}) scale(${s})">`; svg += `<ellipse cx="0" cy="${bob}" rx="16" ry="11" fill="${col}" stroke="#A06820" stroke-width="${ol*0.4}"/>`; svg += `<path d="M9 ${-4+bob} Q14 ${-16+bob} 12 ${-26+bob}" fill="none" stroke="${col}" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>`; svg += `<circle cx="12" cy="${-30+bob}" r="5.5" fill="#D4964A" stroke="#A06820" stroke-width="${ol*0.3}"/>`; svg += `<ellipse cx="8" cy="${-34+bob}" rx="2.5" ry="4.5" fill="${col}" transform="rotate(-20 8 ${-34+bob})"/>`; svg += `<ellipse cx="16" cy="${-34+bob}" rx="2.5" ry="4.5" fill="${col}" transform="rotate(20 16 ${-34+bob})"/>`; svg += `<path d="M9 ${-36+bob} Q4 ${-46} 2 ${-50}" fill="none" stroke="#8B6B4A" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>`; svg += `<path d="M6 ${-43+bob} Q4 ${-48} 5 ${-52}" fill="none" stroke="#8B6B4A" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>`; svg += `<path d="M15 ${-36+bob} Q20 ${-46} 22 ${-50}" fill="none" stroke="#8B6B4A" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>`; svg += `<circle cx="14" cy="${-31+bob}" r="1.3" fill="#222"/>`; svg += `<ellipse cx="16" cy="${-28+bob}" rx="1.8" ry="1.3" fill="#3A2818"/>`; for(let i=0;i<4;i++) svg += `<line x1="${-8+i*6}" y1="${9+bob}" x2="${-8+i*6}" y2="${18+bob}" stroke="#A06820" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>`; if(fawn){ svg += `<ellipse cx="-16" cy="${4+bob}" rx="9" ry="6" fill="#D4A050" stroke="#A07830" stroke-width="${ol*0.3}"/>`; svg += `<circle cx="-11" cy="${-7+bob}" r="4" fill="#D4A050" stroke="#A07830" stroke-width="${ol*0.3}"/>`; svg += `<circle cx="-9" cy="${-8+bob}" r="1" fill="#222"/>`; } svg += `</g>`; return svg;
